configuration.candidate_source: MIND's supplied candidate list for each impression, not the full catalog

limitations: Computed from the licensed MIND dataset, which this repository does not redistribute, so these numbers cannot be reproduced from a public clone without supplying the dataset locally.
Public CI verifies wiring against synthetic artifacts only; it does not reproduce any number in this report.
Scored against MIND's supplied candidate list for each impression rather than the full catalog, so these are not full-catalog retrieval numbers.
Labels come from exposure-biased MIND logs: an item recorded as not clicked may never have been shown.
Post-selection development evaluation on the validation split. No untouched final split remains, so these are not generalization estimates.
Diversity and freshness are slate-shape measurements, not user outcomes: nothing here shows a reader preferred the reranked slate.

metric_definitions.catalog_coverage_at_k: share of the catalog appearing across all served slates
metric_definitions.catalog_size: number of items in the catalog at evaluation time
metric_definitions.distinct_items_recommended: count of unique items appearing in any served slate
metric_definitions.fallback_to_popularity_count: impressions where the baseline had no signal and fell back to global popularity ordering
metric_definitions.fraction_of_slates_below_fresh_quota: share of slates holding fewer fresh items than the configured minimum
metric_definitions.hit_rate_at_k: share of impressions with at least one clicked item in the served Top-K
metric_definitions.impressions_evaluated: impressions the metric was computed over
metric_definitions.k: size of the served Top-K slate
metric_definitions.mean_age_days: mean age in days of the items in the served slate
metric_definitions.mean_distinct_categories: mean count of distinct categories in the served slate
metric_definitions.mean_fresh_fraction: mean share of slate items newer than the freshness threshold
metric_definitions.mean_max_category_count: mean size of the largest single-category group in the served slate
metric_definitions.model: identifier of the baseline or model the row describes
metric_definitions.mrr: mean reciprocal rank of the first clicked item in the served Top-K
metric_definitions.ndcg_at_k: normalised discounted cumulative gain over the served Top-K
metric_definitions.recall_at_k: clicked items in the Top-K divided by all clicked items in the impression

sampling.method: no sampling -- every eligible impression in the split was evaluated
